文件已变更，请检查更新后的清单再发送；重试时请重新加入待发送: Files changed. Review the updated draft before sending; add the batch back to retry.
源文件记录不可用，请重新添加文件: Source file references are unavailable. Add the files again.
对方确认后才会开始传输: Transfer starts after the receiver accepts
加入待发送，重新选择设备: Add to draft and choose a device
本批文件和接收设备已固定，新添加的文件不会加入本次传输。: This batch and its receiver are fixed. Newly added files stay separate.
管理文件保存到本机的位置，以及接收确认方式。: Manage where incoming files are saved and how requests are approved.
只影响本机收到的文件，不是对方的保存位置。: Applies to files received here, not the other device’s save location.
已配对不代表自动接收，可在设备详情中单独设置。: Pairing does not enable automatic receiving. Configure it per device.
开启后，来自此设备的文件会自动保存到本机，无需逐次确认。: Files from this device will be saved here without asking each time.
这不会自动发送文件，也不改变对方的接收设置。: This does not send files automatically or change the other device’s settings.
未配对设备不能开启自动接收。: Pair this device before enabling automatic receiving.
查看设备不会选择发送目标，请回到主页面明确点击设备发送。: Viewing details does not select a receiver. Click a device on the main page to send.
接收请求已处理或已过期: This request was handled or has expired
以后自动接收来自此设备的文件: Automatically receive future files from this device
浏览器预览无法读取真实文件路径，请在桌面应用中添加文件: Add files in the desktop app; browser previews cannot access real file paths
状态仅为浏览器演示，不会发送文件或修改设备设置。: Browser demo only. Files are not sent and device settings are not changed.
这条记录已被删除或清理，无法查看附近记录。: This record was deleted or expired. Nearby records could not be opened.
这条记录已被删除或清理，请返回搜索重新选择。: This record was deleted or expired. Return to search and choose another record.
请先确认请求设备上显示的配对码一致。仅允许你认识并信任的设备接入。: Confirm that the same pairing code appears on the requesting device. Allow only devices you know and trust.
从本机捕获到远程输入: From local capture to remote input
连接后显示完整路径: The full path appears after connection
所选时间范围内的活动: Activity in the selected time range
所选时间范围内暂无事件: No events in this time range
需要进一步排查时，可开启详细日志或导出诊断包。: For further troubleshooting, enable detailed logging or export a diagnostic bundle.
启用跨屏输入后，查看连接与输入状态。: Enable cross-screen input to view connection and input status.
请确认另一台设备已开启 ArcRelay，并连接到同一网络。: Make sure ArcRelay is running on the other device and both devices are on the same network.
请检查本机的鼠标、键盘与辅助功能权限。: Check this device’s mouse, keyboard and accessibility permissions.
请检查目标设备的输入权限与能力信息。: Check the target device’s input permissions and capabilities.
连接可用，但输入延迟偏高: Connected, but input latency is high
延迟超过 16 ms 目标，建议检查网络与设备负载。: Latency exceeds the 16 ms target. Check network conditions and device load.
连接可用，仍需排列屏幕位置: Connected; arrange your screens to continue
请在布局与通道中排列屏幕，建立相邻的跨屏边缘。: Arrange screens in Layout and routes to create adjacent screen edges.
连接已就绪，等待输入样本: Connected and ready for input samples
移动鼠标穿越屏幕边缘后，即可查看输入延迟。: Move the pointer across a screen edge to see input latency.
连接与输入能力可用，延迟在目标范围内。: Connection and input are available. Latency is within target.
仅应用内鼠标；键盘输入返回电脑: Mouse control within the app; keyboard input returns to the computer
轻声确认操作，及时提醒结果: Subtle feedback for actions and results
独立于桌面通知；关闭后保留各项选择。: Independent of desktop notifications. Turning this off keeps your individual choices.
仅调整 ArcRelay 提示音，不改变系统音量。: Adjust ArcRelay sounds without changing system volume.
隐私模式开启时暂停声音反馈，包括试听。: Pause sounds, including previews, while screen privacy is active.
提示音已暂停，将自动恢复。: Sounds are paused and will resume automatically.
暂停一小时，不改变长期偏好。: Pause for one hour without changing your preferences.
浏览器预览可调整开关；声音试听请使用桌面应用。: You can adjust switches in this preview. Use the desktop app to preview sounds.
从剪贴板面板复制或粘贴: Copy or paste from clipboard history
只影响这台设备上的提示音；任务和桌面通知照常运行。: Only affects sounds on this device. Tasks and desktop notifications continue normally.
为每个 Agent 创建独立令牌，一键复制包含鉴权的配置。撤销某个令牌不会影响其: Create a separate token for each agent and copy its authenticated configuration. Revoking one token does not affect other agents.
发送通知并查询已读状态: Send notifications and check read status
查询快捷动作、自动化、本机应用和设备: Find quick actions, automations, local apps and devices
管理快捷动作和自动化，包含删除与恢复: Manage quick actions and automations, including deletion and restoration
启停自动化，修改正在使用的动作和全局快捷键: Enable or disable automations, edit active actions and bind global shortcuts
允许 Agent 发起真实执行和测试: Allow the agent to execute actions and run tests with real effects
允许配置和执行 Shell、AppleScript 等脚本: Allow Shell, AppleScript and other script content, within the granted management and execution permissions
配置已复制，粘贴给桌面 Agent 即可添加。: Configuration copied. Paste it into your desktop agent to set it up.
配置包含令牌，请仅粘贴给你信任的 Agent。ArcRelay 需要保持运行。: The configuration includes a token. Only paste it into an agent you trust. Keep ArcRelay running.
原有配置继续只访问通知。新增管理能力请创建独立令牌。: The original configuration retains notification access only. Create a separate token for management access.
令牌已撤销，新的调用会立即被拒绝。: Token revoked. New requests will be rejected immediately.
Agent 已停用，新的调用会立即被拒绝。: Agent disabled. New requests will be rejected immediately.
Agent 已重新授权，新配置已复制。: Agent reauthorized. The new configuration has been copied.
ArcRelay 在前台时可用页面状态代替系统通知。: When ArcRelay is in the foreground, in-app status can replace system notifications.
ArcRelay 的所有活动都会提醒你。: You will be notified about all ArcRelay activity.
不显示设备名、文件名和错误信息: Hide device names, file names, and error details
为这个 Agent 单独授权，之后可以随时调整或停用。: Grant access to this Agent separately. You can change or disable it at any time.
你已按功能调整提醒内容。: You have customized reminders by feature.
停用后，这个 Agent 将无法继续访问 ArcRelay。继续吗？: This Agent will no longer be able to access ArcRelay. Continue?
只可发送和读取通知: Can only send and read notifications
只提醒需要处理的事项和失败结果。: Only notify you about items that need attention and failures.
可管理、运行并使用脚本: Manage and run actions, including scripts
可读取、管理并启停快捷动作: Read, manage, enable, and disable quick actions
启停自动化，修改动作和全局快捷键: Enable automations and edit actions and global shortcuts
声音与通知已恢复默认: Sound and notification settings restored to defaults
所有访问均在本机授权，可随时停用: All access is authorized locally and can be disabled at any time
按功能调整声音与桌面通知: Adjust sound and desktop notifications by feature
接入后可在这里单独管理权限和停用访问。: Once connected, you can manage permissions or disable access here.
操作确认与重要结果使用轻提示音: Use subtle sounds for confirmations and important results
新接入默认可查看并管理配置；运行脚本仍需单独确认。: New Agents can view and manage configurations by default; running scripts still requires separate approval.
暂停提示音，桌面通知仍按隐私规则显示: Pause sounds while desktop notifications continue to follow privacy rules
更换后，旧配置会立即失效。继续吗？: The old configuration will stop working immediately. Continue?
查看权限、复制新配置或停用这个 Agent。: Review permissions, copy a new configuration, or disable this Agent.
自定义格式、令牌与访问记录: Custom formats, tokens, and access history
让你信任的 Agent 安全使用 ArcRelay: Let trusted Agents use ArcRelay securely
让重要提醒及时到达，其余保持安静: Deliver important alerts on time and keep everything else quiet
请保持 ArcRelay 服务运行后再接入 Agent: Keep the ArcRelay service running before connecting an Agent
这个接入只能发送和读取通知，不能管理或运行操作。: This integration can only send and read notifications; it cannot manage or run actions.
配置包含一次性可复制的访问令牌，请只交给你信任的 Agent。: The configuration contains a copy-once access token. Only share it with an Agent you trust.
锁屏时隐藏通知详情: Hide notification details on the lock screen
需处理、失败和重要完成: Action required, failures, and important completions
需要你处理或任务失败时提醒；重要传输完成也会通知。: Notify you when action is required or a task fails, and when important transfers finish.
需要处理的事项会通过系统通知提醒你: System notifications alert you when something needs attention
请将 ArcRelay MCP 添加到当前桌面 Agent，保留其他 MCP 配: Add ArcRelay MCP to the current desktop agent. Preserve other MCP configurations and only add or update the arcrelay entry. The configuration contains a token; do not repeat it in replies or logs.
请选择匹配客户端的一种配置，不要混用。它们使用 ArcRelay 自带的本地接入: Choose the configuration matching your client; do not combine them. Both use the local connection process bundled with ArcRelay, require no Node or bridge packages, and automatically follow port changes.
配置后请验证连接，并说明是否需要重启或重新加载客户端。请保持 ArcRelay: After configuration, verify the connection and explain whether the client needs restarting or reloading. Keep ArcRelay running; access permissions can be changed or revoked in ArcRelay settings.
复制失败，请在“管理”中重试复制配置。已完成的授权仍然有效。: Copy failed. Retry copying the configuration in Manage. Any completed authorization remains valid.
无法完成托盘操作，请重试。: Could not complete the tray action. Please try again.
附近传输：进行中 {active} · 等待确认 {waiting} · 已暂停: Nearby transfers: Active {active} · Awaiting approval {waiting} · Paused {paused}
设备已离线或不再支持文件浏览: The device is offline or no longer supports file browsing
托盘指定接收设备：{name}。点击设备确认发送；离线时不会自动改发。: Recipient chosen in tray: {name}. Click the device to confirm sending; an offline recipient is never replaced automatically.
支持多文件，文件夹请先压缩: Multiple files supported. Zip folders first.
请在接收设备上打开 ArcRelay，并连接同一网络: Open ArcRelay on the receiving device and connect to the same network.
文件保留在本机，可重新选择设备发送: Your files are still on this device. Choose a device to try again.
请在接收设备上确认本次传输: Confirm this transfer on the receiving device.
准备完成后将开始传输: Transfer will start when preparation finishes.
关闭面板后，传输仍会继续: Transfers continue when this panel is closed.
设备已离线，请重新选择: Device offline. Choose a device again.
该设备正在接收文件，请稍后再试: This device is receiving files. Try again later.
文件已更改，请确认后再次发送: Files have changed. Review them and send again.
请重新添加文件后重试: Add the files again and retry
启动后及每 6 小时检查一次所选更新通道。: Check the selected update channel after launch and every 6 hours.
稳定版适合日常使用；测试版会随 main 的每次成功构建更新。: Stable is recommended for daily use. Test updates after every successful main build.
创建或删除用于整理剪贴板记录的标签。: Create or delete labels used to organize clipboard items.
可以切换其他标签，或返回查看全部剪贴板记录。: Switch to another label or return to all clipboard items.
双向校对文本、图片和标签，核验共享记录数量与版本。本机文件历史单独保留。: Reconcile text, images and labels in both directions, verifying shared record counts and versions. Local file history is retained separately.
接收更新 {received} 次 · 发送更新 {sent} 次 · 标签更新: Received updates {received} · Sent updates {sent} · Label updates {labels} · Syncable records {total}
